senses.gloss:
khecarīmudrā
------------------------------------------
Haṭhayoga aims at purifying and strengthening the body so that राजयोग can then be taken up.
Of the various processes prescribed by the works on हठयोग to purify the body and control the prāṇic energy, the mudras are also one. One of these is the खेचरीमुद्रा. Here, the tongue has to be folded back to close the suṣumnānāḍī, after drawing the प्राण from the iḍā and the पिङ्गला into the सुषुम्ना to retain it there.
These details have to be learnt from an expert teacher. Otherwise it can lead to disastrous consequences.
It is also the name of one of the poses of hands.
See also MUDRĀS.
